rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for approving or supporting a proposal, decision, or course of action.

example.english: I approve of you doing it this way.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zaan3 sing4 nei5 dei6 gam2 joeng6 zou6

rows.note: Use this when approving of something because you appreciate its quality or think well of it, rather than merely giving formal permission.

example.english: I really approve of the thought you put into your report.
example.traditional: 我好欣賞你份報告嘅心思。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 jan1 soeng2 nei5 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 sam1 si1

rows.note: Use this for the sense of accepting someone or something as satisfactory, such as a parent accepting a daughter's boyfriend.

example.english: I approve of your boyfriend now.
example.traditional: 我而家接受你個男朋友喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 zip3 sau6 nei5 go3 naam4 pang4 jau5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when an authority officially sanctions, ratifies, or authorizes something.

example.english: The school decided to approve this activity.
example.jyutping: haau6 fong1 pai1 zeon2 zo2 ni1 hong6 wut6 dung6
